mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_selection_run WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate} AND strategy_type = #{strategyType} AND completed = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_selection_run (trade_date, strategy_type, completed, completed_at) VALUES (#{tradeDate}, #{strategyType}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed = 1, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
